text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of this Premier League fixture as under-fire Manchester United face Brentford at Old Trafford!
What a crucial game this could be for Erik ten Hag.

His United side have made a terrible start to 2023-24, losing back-to-back games to open their Champions League campaign and approaching this match 10th in the Premier League table with nine points from seven outings.
The Red Devils have lost their last two league games on this ground against Crystal Palace and Brighton, and another home humiliation would turn up the pressure on Ten Hag.
Brentford have also made an underwhelming start to the season, with Ivan Toney's suspension being compounded by injuries to key players including Kevin Schade, Ben Mee and Rico Henry.
Thomas Frank's team have only won one of their seven Premier League matches this term despite taking the lead on five occasions, though they could leapfrog United in the table with a win here!
Maguire and Evans are brought in as Ten Hag makes two changes to the team beaten 3-2 by Galatasaray on Tuesday.
Raphael Varane misses out with a minor issue after starting that game, while Mejbri drops to the bench.
It's a first league start of the season for former skipper Maguire, but it remains to be seen how United will line up – it could be a back three, or Lindelof could fill in at full-back.
Brentford's selection issues show no signs of abating as Mark Flekken is ruled out through illness and Keane Lewis-Potter misses out with an injury.

Frank is thus forced into two changes from the team held to a 1-1 draw at Nottingham Forest last Sunday as Strakosha makes his Premier League debut between the sticks and Roerslev comes in at right wing-back, in what looks like a 3-5-2 shape.
United could lose three successive home league games for the first time since 1979 here.
The Old Trafford faithful have yet to turn on Ten Hag, but patience might wear thin if they are beaten again in this one.
Can United pick up a vital three points? Kick-off is approaching and we're about to find out!
After the players take the knee in support of the Premier League's 'no room for racism' initiative, United get the ball rolling at a sun-soaked Old Trafford!
There's no back three for United here.
Lindelof has started at left-back with Amrabat and Casemiro forming a double pivot in midfield.
There's a few groans as Onana is pressed by Wissa, but United play through the press calmy on this occasion!
Now it's Strakosha's turn to be put under pressure as Hojlund presses him ferociously, but he gets a rushed clearance away and Brentford can enjoy a spell on the ball.
Brentford win the first corner of the game as Wissa latches onto Jensen's long throw in behind before a quick exchange of passes allows Roerslev to have a cross deflected behind.
OVER! Brentford work the corner neatly, finding Hickey on the edge of the box with a routine straight off the training ground.
He looks to bend a shot into the top-left corner, but it's just too high to trouble Onana!
Danger! Now Strakosha's poor clearance gifts United possession in a good area.
Casemiro whips a deep cross towards Rashford, but his header at the far post is poor and it runs behind.
United have lost six of their 10 games across all competitions so far in 2023-24 while conceding 18 goals, the most they have shipped at this stage of a season since 1966-67 (20).
They desperately need an improved showing here.
We've had a high-octane start at Old Trafford, with neither team being shy in demonstrating their attacking intent.
Mount tracks back well this time to prevent Collins from breaking over halfway.
Hickey goes into the book after losing possession to Fernandes, taking one for the team by hauling the United captain back to prevent the counter.
United get forward to win a corner on the left, which is swung in by Mount.
It's a poor delivery, but he'll get another chance as Norgaard nods it behind.
There are load groans around Old Trafford as Mount sends in another poor kick, which Norgaard clears again.
Wissa looks to break down the right, but Rashford gets back to recover the loose ball.
United have looked dangerous in recent minutes.
Evans floats a long ball into the box, looking for Casemiro's run to the far post, but Hojlund doesn't read it and the striker flicks a header comfortably wide.
Hojlund goes down as Pinnock's clearance smashes into his face, but he's quickly back to his feet and will be okay to continue.
Maguire is involved for the first time as he steps up following good hold-up play from Mbeumo, and the England international trips Hickey on halfway to grant Brentford a free-kick.
Wissa finds space to dart into the box from the right-hand side, with his low effort deflecting behind for a corner.
Brentford find Hickey again with the same set-piece routine and he shoots from 20 yards out... but he drags this one a couple of yards wide!
United put Brentford under pressure with a sustained spell of possession deep inside the Bees' territory, but Mount's clever flick around the corner is intercepted ahead of Fernandes.
Brentford are struggling to get out at the moment.
Dalot's shot from 20 yards out is charged down, then Rashford speeds past Ajer on the left before winning a corner off the former Celtic man.
Danger! Rashford's tame corner is headed clear, and Lindelof's second knock-down is also smashed away.
Mbeumo then leads a rapid Brentford break, and Mount drags Jensen down off the ball to grant the visitors a free-kick 25 yards out, just to the left of the D.
Mbeumo's free-kick is delivered towards the back post, but nobody gets a touch and it runs all the way through.
Heroic defending from Pinnock! Onana's long ball over the top finds Fernandes, who checks back before offloading to Mount.
He looks to pull the trigger from the right side of the box, but Pinnock flies across to make a crucial block.
Nervy play! Onana takes a short goal-kick to Evans, who is dispossessed by Wissa.
Wissa looks to tee up Mbeumo for a tap-in, but the referee blows for a foul on Evans.
Onana will go long from the resulting free-kick!
United have won three of their four Premier League meetings with Brentford (L1), beating them in both home games without conceding (3-0 in 2021-22, 1-0 in 2022-23).

GOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAAAAALLLLLLLL! BRENTFORD LEAD THROUGH JENSEN! Old Trafford is stunned into silence once more – and it's another catalogue of defensive errors! Casemiro's awful pass allows Brentford to create a four-on-four situation.
Wissa's pass is cut out by Lindelof, but it rebounds back off Wissa and falls for Jensen, who places a finish just beyond Onana's dive! 1-0!
Wissa gets the assist, though he didn't know much about it as it rebounded off him before landing at Jensen's feet.
Having seen the replays, this goal might go down as another error from Onana...
Onana has his head in his hands again, he should definitely have done better there as Jensen's finish was nowhere near the corner!
United look to respond immediately through Rashford, who is crowded out on the edge of the area.
The home fans are growing restless as Mount fails to control Casemiro's driven cross.
Brentford are not happy as Wissa is left in a heap by Evans on halfway.
The referee waves play on, however, as the Bees look to play through United's high press.

It's another demoralising start for United, but there may be hope yet... Brentford have won just one of the five previous Premier League games in which they've taken the lead this season, drawing with Tottenham, Crystal Palace, Bournemouth and Forest.
Collins goes up for a deep free-kick, which is taken by Strakosha.
The Irishman appeals for a corner as it's flicked behind, but the referee rules he had the final touch.
Lindelof goes down awkwardly, holding his back after going over the top of Amrabat and Roerslev.
The stand-in left-back is back to his feet to take a throw-in and he looks okay to continue.
Ajer flies into a booming 50-50 with Amrabat and comes out on top, then a careless foul grants Brentford a free-kick.
Hickey drives over halfway as the Bees go forward, but his pass towards Roerslev slides out of play.
SAVE! Lindelof slips a pass into Rashford's feet on the left corner of the box.
He's somewhat fortunate to get through Roerslev's challenge, but a nice drop of the shoulder then opens up space for a shot... only for Strakosha to hold it at his near post!
ALMOST 2-0! Norgaard feeds Mbeumo in an inside-right position.
He opens up his body before bending a shot towards the bottom-left corner with Onana scrambling, but it curls just wide!
Hojlund jumps into a poor challenge on Wissa with his studs showing, and he's perhaps fortunate not to make firmer contact with the Brentford man.
If he had done, a card would have been shown.
We're into the last five minutes of the opening period with the Old Trafford crowd growing restless.
United haven't carved out a clear-cut chance since falling behind.
Rashford runs at Ajer, who slips and brings his opponent down.
United have a free-kick near the left corner of the box, with Fernandes standing over the dead ball...
CLOSE! Fernandes hammers the free-kick goalwards, with Wissa looking to clear in front of the diving Strakosha.
He sends a firm header over his own crossbar, but that could have gone anywhere!
United fail to make anything of their corner, and Brentford win one of their own at the other end as Roerslev makes an underlapping run before crossing behind off Lindelof.
CHANCE! Mbeumo's corner is glanced on by Norgaard at the front post, with Ajer and Collins attacking it at the back.
They're just unable to make contact, and it drops narrowly wide.
Onana wasn't getting across!
Wissa is allowed space to shoot from 30 yards out, but he lashes wildly off target.
United, however, cannot be affording their opponents that sort of space and time.
We're into two minutes of first-half stoppage time as United look to carve out a chance.
Casemiro nods Fernandes' cross back towards the far post, where Hojlund is waiting to turn it home.
However, Pinnock just eases him out of the way and Strakosha can claim before the offside flag is belatedly raised.
Another offside flag leads to further frustration for United as Maguire goes too early from Onana's long punt forwards.
HALF-TIME: MANCHESTER UNITED 0-1 BRENTFORD.

Boos greet the half-time whistle at Old Trafford, where yet another surprise result is on the cards! United have underwhelmed at both ends of the pitch once again, and both Casemiro and Onana will have to assume responsibility for Jensen's goal, which has given Brentford a 1-0 lead.
The Brazilian's misplaced pass set Brentford on the break, and Onana was unable to keep Jensen's finish out despite it being far from the corner.
At the other end, Rashford shot straight at Strakosha from United's best opening, but they have really struggled to carve out clear-cut chances.
This is an absolutely pivotal team talk for Ten Hag!
United can have few complaints about the half-time scoreline.
They have only hit the target with one of six shots totalling 0.37 expected goals (xG).
Ten Hag's team have lacked width with Rashford being tightly marked on the left and Fernandes constantly drifting in from the right.
What can the Dutchman do to turn the tide?
Ten Hag has made a change at the break, with Casemiro hooked after another poor display in midfield.
Eriksen is on in his place, against his former club.
We're under way for the second half! Can United turn this game around, or will it be another chastening defeat for Ten Hag?
No Premier League side has dropped more points from winning positions in the Premier League this season than Brentford (eight).
Will it be a similar story here, or can they hold on?
Norgaard brings Hojlund down with a sliding challenge in midfield, and he becomes the second Brentford player to see yellow.
Jensen looks for Mbeumo's run in behind, but Onana races from his line to claim the loose ball.
United then come forward through Fernandes, but his loose pass sees the attack break down.
Rashford links up with Mount, who pushes a pass out to Dalot on the overlap.
He crosses low, but Brentford's defence stands firm again.
They haven't given anything away inside their own area.
Ten Hag has tweaked things in attack here, with Mount going out to the right and Fernandes tucking inside behind Hojlund.
Neither player managed to impact the first half, so let's see if that switch changes things.
Save! Eriksen goes for goal from range, and his low effort is only parried by Strakosha.
Hojlund is lurking, but Collins gets back to clear the loose ball.
United have conceded first in four successive Premier League matches at Old Trafford for just the third time, having also done so between February and March 2014 and between July and September 2020.
OFF THE LINE! Goalscorer Jensen hurls a massive throw-in into the United area, where Ajer gets a flick-on at the front post.
It looks to be creeping past Onana's dive, but Dalot is there to hammer it clear! So close to 2-0!
Wide! Now Rashford cuts inside before curling a right-footed effort beyond the far post.
That attempt was closer than it initially looked!
Lindelof gets forward on the overlap before cutting it back towards Fernandes, but a navy shirt is there to clear behind for a corner.
Fernandes' set-piece delivery is a deep one beyond Strakosha, but it's headed away.
United are enjoying plenty of possession, but they're resorting to crosses which are being easily dealt with by Brentford's back three of Ajer, Collins and Pinnock.
A loose pass in midfield allows the Bees to relieve the pressure as Wissa scampers over halfway.
Rashford shows great feet to beat his man on the left-hand side before cutting back, but Janelt intercepts before Mount fouls him inside the Brentford box.
More good defending! Hojlund twists and turns as he attempts to find shooting space inside the visitors' area, but he's eventually crowded out.
Wissa breaks, but his pass towards Mbeumo is overhit and it runs all the way through to Onana.
OVER! Eriksen's cross-field ball is knocked down by Mount, allowing Dalot space to shoot, but his poor effort floats over the crossbar.
He should have done better.
Ten Hag makes two further changes.
Antony comes on for his first Premier League appearance since taking a leave of absence.
The ineffective Mount is withdrawn.
Well, well, well.
Rashford is the other player to make way, with Garnacho on.
Perhaps surprisingly, there are big cheers from the home fans, presumably directed towards Garnacho's entrance, rather than the decision to take Rashford off.
Side netting! Hojlund escapes his marker in the left-hand channel, reaching the area before blasting a shot at goal, but he only manages to find the side netting as another opportunity goes begging.
Wissa embarks on a brilliant run down the right before looking for Mbeumo sliding in at the far post, but Onana makes a crucial claim, falling on the ball and holding on.
Collins sees yellow for an off-the-ball foul to halt a United counter.
Eriksen lines up the resulting free-kick...
but his absolutely terrible delivery is beyond everyone in the area!
Now Janelt practically climbs on Amrabat's back to stop him escaping over halfway.
He joins Collins in the book.
Strakosha is down and in need of treatment.
Frank is preparing a couple of substitutions, though those will be in the outfield positions.
Onyeka replaces Janelt, who had just gone into the referee's book.
Meanwhile, Maupay is on for Wissa up front.
He has been excellent on the break and played a key role in Jensen's goal.
Strakosha is back up and able to continue, getting the game restarted with a goal-kick.
BIG SAVE! Fernandes pushes the ball through Jensen's legs before hammering a shot at goal from 25 yards out.
His strike is a sweet one, but Strakosha is equal to it, diving to his right to push the ball to safety.
Ten Hag is going for broke here as United chase an equaliser.
Martial is on for Lindelof.
Brentford have just 17 minutes plus stoppage time remaining as they look to hold on.
To be honest, United haven't created a real clear-cut chance all game, with Fernandes' long-range effort the closest they have come since the break.
They desperately need some inspiration from somewhere.
Garnacho tries to take a quick free-kick, but Ajer intercepts before setting Mbeumo on the break.
Evans gets over to smash the ball out, and Jensen is taking his time over the resulting throw-in.
BRILLIANT DEFENDING! Ajer flicks Jensen's throw on, but United clear and have a three-on-two situation on the break.
Antony curls a lovely pass towards Hojlund, but Pinnock chases the striker back, wins the battle for possession then goes down to earn a free-kick for his team.

POOR FINISH! Brentford are penned back as Amrabat works the ball out to Garnacho on the left side of the box, but the youngster is leaning back as he sends his finish just over the bar! United need to make these chances count!
The Old Trafford faithful are urging their team on as United look to up the tempo.
Hojlund offloads for Martial, who goes down inside the box under no contact whatsoever.
The referee rightly shakes his head.
CLOSE! United keep the pressure on as Fernandes looks for the top-right corner from just outside the area, but he bends his effort just wide of the target! Strakosha wouldn't have gotten to that one.
Maupay is booked for a foul on Evans as we approach the final 10 minutes of the 90.
Unlucky! Brentford are having to do a lot of defending, but they're always a threat on the break.
Evans and Maguire have no chance as Mbeumo speeds into the area, but his cross-shot is just ahead of Maupay and it drifts wide of Onana's right-hand post.
Time is running out for United to find a response here.
Brentford have all 10 outfielders behind the ball, and their low block is proving difficult for the hosts to break down.
ONANA WITH A BIG SAVE! Hickey drifts infield before looking to curl a pass out to Mbeumo.
Evans intercepts but Maupay is on the scene to claim the loose ball before firing at goal from 25 yards out.
His shot is just dipping towards the top-left corner, but Onana tips it over to keep the game alive.
Brentford make a change.
Ghoddos replaces goalscorer Jensen as they take their time over this corner.
ANOTHER SAVE! Norgaard is inexplicably allowed a free header from the left-wing delivery, and Onana has to be alert to push it over!
Nothing comes of Brentford's second corner and United break downfield.
Ghoddos is perhaps fortunate to avoid a booking for a tactical foul, but the Red Devils can look to build some pressure with five minutes of regular time to play!
You could cut the tension at Old Trafford with a knife.
Another patient move ends with Antony cutting inside to shoot, and it deflects behind off Collins for a corner!
Ten Hag makes another substitution.
McTominay replaces Amrabat as United look to pose more of an aerial threat.
Strakosha punches the corner all the way out for a throw-in on the United right.
Dalot takes a leaf out of Jensen's book as he winds up for a long throw... but it barely reaches the area before being cleared.
It's panic stations for United now.
GOOOOAAAAAALLLL, BUT WAIT, THE FLAG IS UP! Brentford concede a free-kick on the United left.
Fernandes hammers a shot at goal, forcing Strakosha to push it out to Garnacho, who crosses from the byline.

Martial flicks it on and McTominay's touch comes off Ajer before finding the net, but the celebrations are cut short by the linesman's flag! The VAR will take a look... but Martial did look to be offside.
NO GOAL! The on-pitch decision is upheld! Martial was clearly offside as he backheeled Garnacho's low cross into the danger zone, where it came off Ajer before beating Strakosha.
United are still 1-0 down!
We're into SIX additional minutes here as United try to avoid another humiliating home defeat.
Ajer wins a goal-kick, and Brentford are closing in on three points!
'You're getting sacked in the morning' is the chant from the Brentford fans, who are taunting Ten Hag.
His job might not be in any imminent danger, but he'll know how important these next four minutes are.
GOOOOOOOOOAAAAAALLLLLLL! MCTOMINAY WITH A DRAMATIC LEVELLER! Garnacho beats Roerslev to reach the byline before crossing for Dalot.
His close-range effort is only parried by Strakosha, and McTominay is there to volley the rebound into the bottom-left corner.
It's 1-1, and United will be pushing for a winner now!
There's a quick VAR check to ascertain whether Garnacho kept the ball in play on the left wing, but it's soon cleared! The goal stands, and Old Trafford sense another potential twist to come...
STRAIGHT AT THE GOALKEEPER! Brentford are clinging onto their point now as Pinnock blocks Eriksen's cross, but it drops straight to Martial.
He shoots first-time, but it's too close to Strakosha!

GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!! MCTOMINAY AGAIN! WILD SCENES AT OLD TRAFFORD! What a huge moment this could be for Ten Hag! United win a deep free-kick, which is hoisted towards Maguire at the far post.
He helps it into the centre, where McTominay escapes his marker to nod home! Strakosha got a touch, but he could only divert it against the post and in.
From 1-0 down, United lead 2-1 courtesy of two stoppage-time goals!
Maguire gets a vital assist on his first Premier League start of the season, heading the free-kick across for McTominay to get his brace!
FULL-TIME: MANCHESTER UNITED 2-1 BRENTFORD.
Wow.
What a difference four minutes can make.

United were starring down the barrel of a third successive home defeat in the Premier League, one which may have had huge implications for Ten Hag's future, after Onana failed to keep Jensen's shot out in the first half.

However, McTominay's late introduction proved the turning point, with the Scot levelling in the 93rd minute with a close-range volley, before beating Strakosha with a 97th-minute header to provoke wild celebrations.
It's absolutely gutting for Brentford, but what a relief for United!
The United players stay out to soak up the atmosphere at Old Trafford, where McTominay has played the role of super-sub to fire the Red Devils to a potentially season-defining result.
They move up to ninth in the Premier League table with four wins and four losses this term, while Brentford slump to 14th.
Frank's men are now winless in eight games across all competitions.
We hope you've enjoyed our coverage of the most dramatic of stoppage-time turnarounds.
It's goodbye from us, and we'll see you next time!
